messages:
Maya: Quick design check — on foldable phones in landscape split-screen the left rail gets pushed under the system nav and the main table's rightmost columns get clipped. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/test-foldable-ss.png
Jordan: Repro on emulator with 7.6" folded width. Looks like our sidebar's position:fixed + z-index doesn't play nice with safe-area insets.
Sam: Is this only split-screen? Also happens with keyboard up? Need severity for roadmap triage.
Maya: Primarily split-screen (multi-window). Keyboard can expose it too when the action bar is sticky. Action buttons disappear behind system UI — major usability break for quick actions.
Lee: From research, ~8% of participants on foldables used split-screen to compare logs side-by-side; losing actions blocks common workflows.
Jordan: Quick patch idea: respect env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and bump stacking for floating controls. Example CSS:```
.console-floating {
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
  z-index: 1200; /* attempt to sit above webview overlays */
}
```
Sam: Can we avoid a global z-index bump? Risk of interfering with modals and toasts. Maybe create an explicit stacking context on the rail container (transform: translateZ(0)) and only raise the actionbar.
Jordan: Good point. I'll try: `.rail-container { position: relative; transform: translateZ(0); }` + safe-area padding on `.console-floating`. Also add visual regression screenshot for foldable viewport.
Maya: UX tweak: at widths <420px we should compress columns and expose a horizontal scroll only when necessary. Avoid hiding actions behind system chrome.
Lee: Accessibility note: when we truncate cell text, ensure header tooltips and `aria-label` include the full value so screen reader users still get content.
Sam: Proposed priority: 1) z-index + safe-area patch (hotfix candidate), 2) header tooltips + aria-labels, 3) breakpoint adjustments and horizontal scroll policy. Target: next minor release if PR lands this week.
Jordan: Opening PR with patch + screenshot tests now, will add test for split-screen foldable viewport.
deploy-bot: CI passed for branch fix/foldable-z (build 2891).
Maya: Thanks — will schedule UX review once PR is ready. :thumbsup:
